verses.original: אֶפְרַ֜יִם רֹעֶ֥ה ר֙וּחַ֙ וְרֹדֵ֣ף קָדִ֔ים כָּל־ הַיּ֕וֹם יַרְבֶּ֑ה כָּזָ֥ב וָשֹׁ֖ד יִכְרֹ֔תוּ וּבְרִית֙ עִם־ אַשּׁ֣וּר יוּבָֽל׃ וְשֶׁ֖מֶן לְמִצְרַ֥יִם
verses.transliteration: ’ep̄·ra·yim rō·‘eh rū·aḥ wə·rō·ḏêp̄ qā·ḏîm kāl- hay·yō·wm yar·beh kā·zāḇ wā·šōḏ yiḵ·rō·ṯū ū·ḇə·rîṯ ‘im- ’aš·šūr yū·ḇāl wə·še·men lə·miṣ·ra·yim
verses.literal: Ephraim feeds on the wind and pursues the east wind all day long he multiplies lies and violence he makes a covenant with Assyria and sends olive oil to Egypt

verses.original: לַֽיהוָ֖ה וְרִ֥יב עִם־ יְהוּדָ֑ה וְלִפְקֹ֤ד עַֽל־ יַעֲקֹב֙ כִּדְרָכָ֔יו יָשִׁ֥יב לֽוֹ׃ כְּמַעֲלָלָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh wə·rîḇ ‘im- yə·hū·ḏāh wə·lip̄·qōḏ ‘al- ya·‘ă·qōḇ kiḏ·rā·ḵāw yā·šîḇ lōw kə·ma·‘ă·lā·lāw
verses.literal: The LORD has a charge to bring against Judah He will punish . . . Jacob according to his ways and repay him according to his deeds

verses.original: בַּבֶּ֖טֶן אָחִ֑יו עָקַ֣ב אֶת־ וּבְאוֹנ֖וֹ שָׂרָ֥ה אֶת־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.literal: In the womb he grasped his brother’s heel - and in his vigor he wrestled with God

verses.original: וָיָּ֤שַׂר אֶל־ מַלְאָךְ֙ וַיֻּכָ֔ל בָּכָ֖ה וַיִּתְחַנֶּן־ ל֑וֹ בֵּֽית־ יִמְצָאֶ֔נּוּ אֵל֙ יְדַבֵּ֥ר עִמָּֽנוּ׃ וְשָׁ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wāy·yā·śar ’el- mal·’āḵ way·yu·ḵāl bā·ḵāh way·yiṯ·ḥan·nen- lōw bêṯ- yim·ṣā·’en·nū ’êl yə·ḏab·bêr ‘im·mā·nū wə·šām
verses.literal: Yes, he struggled with the angel and prevailed he wept and sought His favor he found Him at Bethel and spoke with Him there
the LORD God of Hosts the LORD is His name of renown

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֖ה תָשׁ֑וּב בֵּאלֹהֶ֣יךָ שְׁמֹ֔ר חֶ֤סֶד וּמִשְׁפָּט֙ תָּמִֽיד׃ וְקַוֵּ֥ה אֶל־ אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ṯā·šūḇ bê·lō·he·ḵā šə·mōr ḥe·seḏ ū·miš·pāṭ tā·mîḏ wə·qaw·wêh ’el- ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: But you must return to your God maintain love and justice and always wait on your God

verses.original: כְּנַ֗עַן אָהֵֽב׃ לַעֲשֹׁ֥ק מִרְמָ֖ה מֹאזְנֵ֥י בְּיָד֛וֹ
verses.literal: A merchant loves to defraud with dishonest scales in his hands

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֔יִם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַ֣ךְ עָשַׁ֔רְתִּי מָצָ֥אתִי א֖וֹן לִ֑י כָּל־ יְגִיעַ֕י יִמְצְאוּ־ לִ֖י לֹ֥א עָוֺ֥ן אֲשֶׁר־ חֵֽטְא׃
verses.transliteration: ’ep̄·ra·yim way·yō·mer ’aḵ ‘ā·šar·tî mā·ṣā·ṯî ’ō·wn lî kāl- yə·ḡî·‘ay yim·ṣə·’ū- lî lō ‘ā·wōn ’ă·šer- ḥêṭ
verses.literal: And Ephraim boasts . . . How rich I have become I have found wealth for myself In all my labors they can find in me no iniquity that [is] sinful

verses.original: וְאָנֹכִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אוֹשִֽׁיבְךָ֥ עֹ֛ד בָאֳהָלִ֖ים כִּימֵ֥י מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·nō·ḵî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ’ō·wō·šî·ḇə·ḵā ‘ōḏ ḇā·’o·hā·lîm kî·mê mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: But I [am] the LORD your God ever since the land of Egypt I will again make you dwell . . . in tents as in the days of the appointed feast

verses.original: וְדִבַּ֙רְתִּי֙ עַל־ הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים וְאָנֹכִ֖י הִרְבֵּ֑יתִי חָז֣וֹן אֲדַמֶּֽה׃ וּבְיַ֥ד הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏib·bar·tî ‘al- han·nə·ḇî·’îm wə·’ā·nō·ḵî hir·bê·ṯî ḥā·zō·wn ’ă·ḏam·meh ū·ḇə·yaḏ han·nə·ḇî·’îm
verses.literal: I spoke through the prophets and multiplied their visions I gave parables through the prophets

verses.original: אִם־ אָ֙וֶן֙ גִּלְעָ֥ד אַךְ־ הָי֔וּ שָׁ֣וְא זִבֵּ֑חוּ שְׁוָרִ֣ים בַּגִּלְגָּ֖ל גַּ֤ם מִזְבְּחוֹתָם֙ כְּגַלִּ֔ים עַ֖ל תַּלְמֵ֥י שָׂדָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’ā·wen gil·‘āḏ ’aḵ- hā·yū šāw zib·bê·ḥū šə·wā·rîm bag·gil·gāl gam miz·bə·ḥō·w·ṯām kə·ḡal·lîm ‘al tal·mê śā·ḏāy
verses.literal: Is there iniquity [in] Gilead They will surely come to nothing Do they sacrifice bulls in Gilgal Indeed their altars [will be] heaps of stones in the furrows of the field

verses.original: יַעֲקֹ֖ב וַיִּבְרַ֥ח שְׂדֵ֣ה אֲרָ֑ם יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיַּעֲבֹ֤ד בְּאִשָּׁ֔ה וּבְאִשָּׁ֖ה שָׁמָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yiḇ·raḥ śə·ḏêh ’ă·rām yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·‘ă·ḇōḏ bə·’iš·šāh ū·ḇə·’iš·šāh šā·mār
verses.literal: Jacob fled to the land of Aram and Israel worked for a wife for a wife he tended [sheep]

verses.original: וּבְנָבִ֕יא יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ הֶעֱלָ֧ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וּבְנָבִ֖יא נִשְׁמָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nā·ḇî Yah·weh ’eṯ- he·‘ĕ·lāh yiś·rā·’êl mim·miṣ·rā·yim ū·ḇə·nā·ḇî niš·mār
verses.literal: But by a prophet the LORD - brought Israel out of Egypt and by a prophet he was preserved

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֖יִם תַּמְרוּרִ֑ים הִכְעִ֥יס אֲדֹנָֽיו׃ יִטּ֔וֹשׁ וְדָמָיו֙ עָלָ֣יו יָשִׁ֥יב ל֖וֹ וְחֶ֨רְפָּת֔וֹ
verses.transliteration: ’ep̄·ra·yim tam·rū·rîm hiḵ·‘îs ’ă·ḏō·nāw yiṭ·ṭō·wōš wə·ḏā·māw ‘ā·lāw yā·šîḇ lōw wə·ḥer·pā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Ephraim has provoked bitter anger so his Lord will leave his bloodguilt upon him and repay him for his contempt
